Escalated rows carry next_phase PH-AUTH-006 - shape 2, an escalated row whose next phase is knowable regardless of how the decision resolves. PH-AUTH-006 acts on all of these either way: a crate ruled out of v1 scope is removed there, one ruled in is decomposed there, and a test whose owning requirement is still being identified is still maintained by whoever owns its crate. Leaving next_phase null on these rows was shape 4, which is for a phase that genuinely depends on the answer - and none of these do. Shape 4 remains legal and is now unused.

The public-types evidence rule asked whether a test or example NAMES the identifier. That is a string proxy and it mislabelled 60 of 229 items (26%): inference-bound return types are never written (a test destructures FixedStepBatch without naming it), constants are asserted as literals, trait bounds are required on every call site, and error payloads are matched structurally. Items consumed by another crate in the workspace are now retained. The residue is the honest unexercised surface. Reachability analysis is the correct long-term answer and is carried to PH-AUTH-006.
